result.summary: The intersection is highly hostile to pedestrians, characterized by a complete lack of sidewalks and dedicated pedestrian signals. The wide, multi-lane roadway creates long, unprotected crossing distances with no visible refuge islands or safe waiting areas.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Facilities
hazards.description: There are no sidewalks or marked crosswalks for the primary directions of travel, forcing pedestrians into the roadway or onto unpaved shoulders.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the intersection and along the road edges.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane intersection requires pedestrians to cross a large expanse of asphalt without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking in the asphalt surface can create tripping hazards and uneven footing.

interventions.title: Sidewalk and Curb Ramp Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings and pedestrian countdown signals to clearly define crossing areas and provide dedicated time for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Modify the existing median to include a raised refuge island, allowing pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized residential intersection with a marked continental crosswalk and curb ramps. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide roadway and lack of visible pedestrian signals or refuge islands increase exposure for people crossing.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signals are visible to indicate when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Median Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and marked crosswalks, controlled by traffic signals. However, dense mature foliage on the corners creates significant visual obstructions that may hide pedestrians from approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense ivy and low-hanging tree branches on the left corner block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry appears wide, which can encourage higher vehicle speeds during right-hand turns.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the roadway.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove dense foliage near the intersection to restore clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade standard parallel line crosswalks to continental or ladder markings to increase visibility to drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a high-speed, multi-lane arterial road with a long, unprotected pedestrian crossing. While a faded zebra crosswalk is present, the environment lacks pedestrian signals, refuge islands, or continuous sidewalks, making it highly hostile for non-motorized users.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of high-speed traffic without any mid-point refuge.

hazards.name: Lack of Signalization
hazards.description: There are no traffic or pedestrian signals to control vehicle flow and provide a safe crossing interval.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The roadway surface within and near the crosswalk is cracked and patched, creating potential tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground at the start of the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to reduce crossing distance and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (HAWK)
interventions.description: Install a pedestrian-activated signal to provide a protected crossing phase across the multi-lane roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Replace the faded markings with high-visibility continental-style stripes to improve driver awareness.
